steps.note: S2.3.1.1 gives the row-by-row schedule (rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc, rows 2-3 change scratch, rows 4-5 add, rows 6-7 restore c,a) and concludes the net target change (JV+RG)x is independent of a and c, matching the paper.
S2.3.1.2 states central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero for intersections zero/two, self coefficient one.
S2.3.1.3 states central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one, both nets y<-y+x.
S2.3.1.4 gives forward, inverse (X<-X-Y), forward stages taking (x,y) to (x,y+x), (-y,y+x), (-y,x), each invocation restoring its own scratch wires.

The plan asserts every edge joins nested labels (S2.3.3.1, S2.3.3.1.6) and says 'splitting A=B perp P, F=<t> perp t^perp gives every other residual' (S2.3.3.1.8), but never lists the per-edge residuals or their dimensions (the residual table).
S2.3.3.1.7 states that on side edge 2->5 t_X perp t_Y gives <t_X> inside t_Y^perp, with complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2.
Only decreasing edges are center 3->4 losing h (S2.3.3.1.6); telescoping at gates, sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N, and +2L with L=Ich for absolute changes are all stated (S2.3.3.2.1-3).

S2.3.3.3 states residuals are nondegenerate, nonzero ones contain a norm-one vector from coordinate units outside small supports hence nonalternating, hence have an orthonormal basis; the alternating-plane absorption proof is not spelled out but the claim chain is.
S2.3.3.4 gives L/N = 3ch/v with exact values 100/539 (bit) and 101/539 (complex), both below 1/2.
S2.3.5.1 states weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors and q_V-q_U = sum over an orthonormal residual basis of wt(v)[v.x], sign reversed on decreasing edges.
S2.3.5.2 states wt(v) odd, phase i^{eps[v.x]} expanded as (1+i^eps)/2 + (1-i^eps)/2 (-1)^{v.x}, and H diag(1,-1) H = X giving aI+bX_v or its inverse.
S2.3.5.4 states that on k columns each residual vector contributes one factor acting on all k columns, s_c factors over the network.

S2.3.5.5 gives zero label frame I and full label C^{tensor m}; S2.3.5.6 gives C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) repaired by Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after via C=iZC^{-1}Z; S2.3.5.7 negates the physical X outputs.
L/N below 1/2 gives positive deficit N-2L_b (S2.3.4.5) and 2N-2L_c (S2.3.5.3), hence s<Wm (S2.3.3).
S2.3.6 states both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, log m<20, m^{1-2^-50} > m(1-20*2^-50) > m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50 (quote of the paper's lines in the same role).

The plan gives the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clearing by lower-triangular elementary operations on left and below, repetition on remaining indices, and exactly a ones in Pi with E1=L^-1, E2=R^-1.

S2.4.1.1 method factors once and for all over a fixed finite set of matrices and picks the fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators, working over Z/q^b with diagonal units; the specialization is stated tersely but the content is there.
S2.4.1.1.2 states a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V), updating coordinates in descending physical order with earlier coordinates still holding original values.
S2.4.1.1.3 realizes each one of Pi by D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j with one interchange each, a interchanges in all.
S2.5.5 and S2.5.5.1 give E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu as least j with m^j>=B, C_0=128m(s+E)^2=128mB^2, Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}), C_1=20; max{20,nu+3} and nu=11 are not spelled out.

S2.5.5 method gives A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at internal nodes and A(e)<=8e at leaves, and S2.5.5.1 derives the per-invocation count below E from at most 12W gates of at most 2W^2 operations plus child and endpoint corrections.

S2.5.5.1 only asserts A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} 'through ceil(log_m d) levels'; the unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu and the total bound (piece count, outer phases, shift) below C_0 d^{C_1} are not derived, only the final C_0 d^{C_1} result is asserted.

S2.5.5.2 gives depth-t values in 2^{-(p+t)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^t by induction; S2.5.5 states p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact; S2.5.5.3 gives epsilon C_1<1 implies Delta=o(p).
S2.5.7 states every row of H has absolute row sum one so disk arrays map to disk arrays, and the single final truncation toward zero adds error below sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: 24 of 26 sub-steps present. Absent: L1 (the per-edge residual table with dimensions is never listed; only the nestedness claim and a few individual residuals appear) and S3 (the unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu and the total bound below C_0 d^{C_1} are asserted, not derived). No sub-step is stated contrary to the paper. Borderline presents: L4 (orthonormal-basis claim without the alternating-plane absorption proof) and M2 (prime avoiding denominators and diagonal numerators stated tersely).
